messages:
Evelyn Park: FYI exec update for teams: short term focus is stability for Dedicated customers, clearer launch playbooks, and a sprint on cost optimizations.

Jonas Meyer: can you clarify "clearer launch playbooks"? curious what level of detail you want.

Evelyn Park: playbooks = checklist + canary gates + rollback steps + customer comms template. Needs to be usable by CE during pilot signoff.

Samira Ali: release-bot, status on dedicated canary?

release-bot: 2211110025 Canary for dedicated-v2 running in us-west. Traffic ramp 15% -> 50% planned over 48h. No errors currently.

Jonas Meyer: infra note: we found a config that reduces token-cost by 6% for transformer-xl variants using mixed-quant. We'll schedule a canary on non-production first.

Evelyn Park: good. ensure canary includes metrics for quality regression. no cost wins at the expense of hallucination.

Samira Ali: product will produce a one-page cheat sheet for CE and sales for pilot handoff. ETA: Wed.

Evelyn Park: org ask: 1) freeze experimental infra changes for the next 4 weeks in dedicated pools. 2) each team to submit one reliability improvement plan by next Tue. 3) exec review of canary checklists before GA.

Jonas Meyer: will share infra plans.

Samira Ali: noted. will consolidate playbook checklist and share in #templates.

Evelyn Park: thanks. small wins: dedicated p95 improved by 10% in last two canaries; cost per token down slightly in test env. Keep alignment tight. :seedling:
